read_only_schema_observation.method: Live SELECT on pg_constraint and information_schema.columns; no data writes.

findings.issue: Two anonymous group voices would project to identical physical rows for one compound proposition.
findings.reason: No physical group-label, clause-key or evidence-unit reference column exists on proposition_voice_chain.
findings.consequence: Distinct staging keys alone cannot preserve reader-versus-jurist clause association after projection.

findings.issue: grouped_named_attribution and single_named_attribution would overstate named-source coverage.
findings.reason: No individual reader or jurist is named in this paragraph.
findings.consequence: Do not substitute invented authority names or put group labels into originating_voice_name, which must be NULL for unattributed_group.

findings.issue: Existing evidence categories do not directly label anonymous reported inference.
findings.consequence: If unattributed_assertion is selected later, retain explicit reported-group and inferential scope in summaries/links, and document the category limitation.

design_options.option: Two atomic child propositions under historical I03 claim
design_options.benefit: Each proposition gets one anonymous-group voice and its own exact clause evidence, preserving the relationship through proposition_id.
design_options.requirements: Review proposition claim-type catalog and draft two-proposition staging shape; coordinate consumer assumptions and keep historical claim count separate from physical proposition count.

design_options.option: One compound proposition plus staging-only clause association
design_options.limitation: Current physical voice schema would lose the distinction; cannot call projection lossless without a verified durable association strategy.

decision: Do not produce a falsely lossless one-proposition/two-identical-voice payload. Next draft should evaluate two scoped child propositions while preserving I03 historical claim identity.
next_step: Read current proposition claim-type catalog and stage a two-child-proposition I03 candidate, with one anonymous group voice per child, exact clause hashes and English absence limits. No schema migration implied.
